text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance and repeated claim that self-driving cars will help","quality":"positioning","description":"It states a definite argument and keeps that position visible throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"three-body structure with intro, supporting paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It is arranged into a recognizable essay structure that helps the reader follow the argument."},{"evidence":"explains how sensors alert the driver and reduce accidents","quality":"supporting explanation","description":"It does more than mention facts by showing how the article’s details support its claim."},{"evidence":"“lower traffic accidents,” “save people money,” “less greenhouse gases”","quality":"development","description":"It develops its case with several connected reasons rather than relying on one or two brief points."},{"evidence":"mentions LIDAR, GPS, radar, and braking response","quality":"specific evidence use","description":"It includes multiple precise details from the source article to ground the argument."},{"evidence":"final paragraph restates benefits and predicts future development","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by summarizing the argument and looking ahead, which gives the essay a finished feel."}]}
